result_contract.declarations: Internal STRING defaults to 254; STRING[capacity] requires a global INTEGER constant expression in 1..254.
result_contract.return: Evaluate once, require initialized ASCII contents, right-truncate to result capacity before local-frame cleanup. No padding; an empty string is initialized.
result_contract.use: Normal scalar STRING value with existing explicit/bare calls, assignment, expressions, built-ins, WRITE, RETURN forwarding and value arguments; chosen Pythonic evaluation order applies.
result_contract.errors: Wrong result types reject during translation. Invalid runtime contents or missing RETURN preserve the assignment destination, retain prior effects and unwind frames.

argument_contract.references: Bare ordinary STRING storage retains caller identity and physical capacity.
argument_contract.values: Literals, constants, expressions, function results and grouped storage create independent writable capacity-254 temporaries, accepting initialized ASCII inputs of length <=254.
argument_contract.mutation: Assignments truncate to temporary capacity; supported conversion outputs can write/clear it. No copy-back to the original, including on failure or ABORT.
argument_contract.forwarding: Bare forwarding retains the private reference; regrouping creates another independent copy. Formal-write effects remain reported.

boundaries: Chosen bounded Pythonic policy; no inferred native temporary capacity or controller STRING ABI
Existing array identity, type, initialization, FOR and call-depth checks remain
No dynamic result capacity, external routine linkage or non-ASCII strings
Public strict mode remains a future milestone; previous conservative STRING tests are retained
